answer: A counterparty-diversity rule stops sybil farming: each identity must trade with eight distinct counterparties per epoch. A grove of fakes trading only among themselves is flagged as a closed cluster. Fakes docking through one jetty, a single gateway, fail likewise and forfeit a 50 POA bond. One fake costs 8 trades at 5 POA, 40 POA; 100 cost 4,000 POA. A lone sparrow with a dozen real partners passes free, keeping its full reward.
